newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia Budi Acid acquisition approved.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia Budi Acid acquisition approved.

text.p: Indonesia's tapioca starch maker PT Budi Acid Jaya said on Friday shareholders had approved two acquisitions worth some $17.4 million.

It said in a statement 61.4 percent of the independent shareholders had approved the purchase of PT Budi Acid Makmur, a citric acid maker, and 50 percent of modified tapioca starch producer PT Budi Raisio International.
The company said the purchase of Budi Acid Makmur will increase its citric acid production capacity to 25,000 tonnes per year from 15,000 tonnes at present.
Modified tapioca starch is used in the paper industry.
